spans.s: --a sacrifice whose fruits are attained by going round अमरकण्टक. M. १८८. ९३.
(I)--the kingdom named after the people. M. १६३. ७३. [page२-393+ ३२]
(II)--a son of Bali, after whom came the name of the kingdom. Vi. IV. १८. १३-14.

(I)--(also पौण्ड्र): King of काशि; son of Vasudeva, and Sutanu, daughter of काशिराज. When he became king, he asserted that he was the real वासुदेव, and married देवकी the youngest sister of Kamsa. Besieged द्वारका during कृष्ण's absence at night, and being put to defeat by बलराम and सात्यकि, went back to his capital. Sent a messenger to कृष्ण saying that he was the real वासु- deva and that कृष्ण was either to give up the title or offer battle. कृष्ण invaded काशि and killed him and his allies;
1: भा. X. ६६. [1-१२], 1-२३. २७. Vi. V. २६. 7; ३४, 4-२८.
